Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8286); Saruch (i.e. Serug), a patriarch:--Saruch.
BiblicalUsage: Saruch stands in the genealogy of Jesus, the son of Ragau, in the line from Shem to Abraham. The Greek text behind the King James Version spells his name with an alpha, while the text I have checked spells it with an epsilon.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the genealogy keeps even the quietest links, and Saruch is there because the chain has no missing piece.
